# P24.5 — Housekeeping backlog (META.1 / GL-META-01; closes BL-052)

Spec: `docs/tickets/P24.5__housekeeping-backlog.md` (Lane C, new code; no gate;
offline-only; `live_verification=false`). Requirement ids: **GL-META-01**.
Deferrals opened: **D-META.1-1 / D-META.1-2** (two `P22+` backlog rows promoted to
tracked obligations). No ADR (pure housekeeping/bookkeeping — no owned design
decision; the landing-enum extension is documented in-file per precedent). No new
RISK (RISK-P20-01 already covers backlog drift; the regenerated mirror + new
tests add compensating controls).

## Summary

Three deterministic ACs, all met: **no package description says "skeleton"**,
**`check_backlog.py` green**, **BL-052 closed in `BACKLOG.csv`** — plus the
contract's real work: honest `P22+` triage and the remaining docs-drift sweep.

**BL-052 — package metadata.** Re-confirmed at build time: **4** packages still
read `"skeleton"` (`db`, `parsing`, `reconcile`, `policy`); `orchestration` was
already re-described by P24.2/SCHED.1 (BL-052's title names five because it
predates that fix). All four re-described accurately in the established style;
`status=closed`, `landing=closed-by:P24.5`.

**`check_backlog.py` — the flagged known issue.** The vendored checker still
pointed `LD`/`THEMES` at the pre-P22.3 paths (`docs/build/*.md`); the files now
live under `docs/build/reports/`, so the checker crashed (`FileNotFoundError`)
and — worse — the themes check had been **silently skipping**. Repointed; the
first real run surfaced **6 unmapped ADR revisit triggers** (ADR-073–078, added
since the last reconcile), each homed in exactly one `sources` cell: ADR-073→BL-002
(monitor-style process ADR), ADR-074/ADR-076→BL-023 (doc-connector live smoke /
cadence observed on real fetches — the row D-LIVE.1a-1 already cites),
ADR-075/ADR-077→BL-037 (infra accounts — nearest home; no HG-12 BL row exists),
ADR-078→BL-048 (the CI-jobs row). Checker now exits **0**: 102/102 risk rows,
77/77 ADR triggers, 90/90 LD rows, 0 duplicates, themes validated again.

**`P22+` triage — real landings, not re-filing.** All 9 rows examined against the
tree: none is landed, none is owned by a remaining manifest ticket (rows 84–87 =
JURIS.2/CCOPS.1/REC.1/GATE-ACCEPT). BL-052 closed by this ticket. The two rows
whose only precondition is real post-go-live state were promoted to
`docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` as owed obligations — **D-META.1-1** (BL-045 ruleset
calibration once real claim volume exists) and **D-META.1-2** (BL-028
records-request outcome log fed live). The remaining six (BL-003/031/041/047/048/
049) carry an honest **`P25+`** landing (the planning round after this manifest),
replacing the stale `P22+` bucket whose "later planning pass" had already closed.
`LANDING_RE` generalised to `closed-by:P<n>.<m>` / `P<n>.<m>` / `P<n>+` so future
tickets land rows without editing the enum.

**`BACKLOG.md` regenerated, deterministically.** The committed mirror had drifted
since the P21.x closures (stale statuses/titles/groupings). New stdlib renderer
`docs/build/tools/build_backlog_md.py` makes it a pure function of the CSV
(`--check` mode for the drift test) — the regeneration itself is the docs-drift
fix, and it can never silently drift again.

**Docs-drift sweep.** The same post-P22.3 moved-path drift fixed wherever a live
pointer existed: vendored tools (`p20_extract.py`, `classify.py`,
`gen_rights_index.py`, `gen_rights_packets.py`, `gen_stage0_record.py`,
`run_okc.sh` — which would have recreated a top-level `docs/build/okc/` on the
next live run, violating the v2 layout), the seven Lane-B re-run contracts
(P21.1/P21.3/P21.4/P21.5/P21.7/P21.8/P21.9 — re-run verbatim, so their Load
pointers must resolve), `00_MANIFEST.md`, `docs/3_sig_golive_spec.md`,
`INTEGRATION_PLAN.md`, `readouts/HUMAN-H1.md`, `reports/rights/_TEMPLATE.md`,
`governance/stage0-outreach-letter.md`. **Deliberately left verbatim:** dated
historical records — `reports/*.md` narratives, `LEDGER.md` PHASE LOG entries,
`DEFERRALS.md` row cells, `pr/*`, `runs/*`, append-only `risk_register.md`/
`traceability.md`, frozen P19/P20/P22/P23 tickets, and README's intentional
old→new migration table. Rewriting those would falsify history (example:
PLANNING_LEDGER §4.7 records P19.1 renaming the ledger to `docs/build/` — true
when written; the reports/ move came later under P22.3).

**LEDGER OPEN FINDINGS.** MATRIX-INT-01 annotated CLOSED — verified the checker
exits 0 (`671 rows OK`; the two enum cells were normalised per the finding's own
prescription).

`check_backlog.py` exits 0 as a real subprocess + its `LD`/`THEMES` constants
point at `docs/build/reports/` and resolve; the landing enum accepts the real

BL-028; `BACKLOG.md` byte-matches the renderer output (any future drift fails);
every `docs/build/…` pointer in the live re-run contracts + manifest resolves;
`run_okc.sh` writes under `reports/okc/`.
